name: WCORR-PERS-001: SSH login → crontab editor → cron modification
description: Detects an SSH login followed by a crontab editor event and a FIM alert for a cron-related file.
query:
sequence by agent.id.keyword with maxspan=30m
  [any where rule.id.keyword == "5715"]
  [any where rule.id.keyword == "2834"]
  [any where rule.id.keyword in ("550", "554") and (
    syscheck.path.keyword like "/var/spool/cron/*" or
    syscheck.path.keyword like "/var/spool/cron/crontabs/*" or
    syscheck.path.keyword like "/etc/cron.d/*" or
    syscheck.path.keyword == "/etc/crontab"
  )]
author: Wazuh EQL Correlation
false_positives: Legitimate cron administration can produce the same sequence; agent and time do not establish actor continuity.
setup: Collect SSH, 2834 crontab-editor alerts and FIM for all specified cron paths.
